about_short_description.short_description: Manufact provides open-source developer tools and infrastructure for the model context protocol.

product.name: mcp-use SDK
product.description: An open-source framework and SDK for building MCP servers, agents, and applications in TypeScript and Python.

product.name: Manufact Cloud
product.description: A managed cloud platform for deploying, running, and managing MCP servers, agents, and related configuration.

product.name: MCP Inspector
product.description: A web-based inspector for testing and debugging MCP servers, tools, widgets, and JSON-RPC traffic.

product.name: MCP Agents
product.description: An agent framework that integrates LLMs with MCP servers to run tool-using AI agents with memory and structured output.

product.name: MCP Apps and UI Widgets
product.description: A set of tools and templates for building MCP Apps with React-based UI widgets that render in ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

product.name: MCP Server Framework
product.description: A TypeScript server framework and templates for building fully compliant MCP servers with hot reload and tooling support.
